verdict.rationale: Meltano's YAML-based project config and idempotent CLI commands (meltano add, meltano run) allow scripting operations across multiple plugins/pipelines, which could be leveraged for bulk automation, but there's no explicit bulk-operation feature, batch API, or multi-item command documented. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch command or API, evidence of running actions across many items simultaneously, AI-native automation examples.
